meta.description: Calculator and study guide for food cost, trim waste and cooking loss, with every formula explained step by step.

menu.title: Menu
menu.signed-out-hint: Keep your settings and calculations in your account.

footer.tagline: A study guide to food cost management.
footer.disclaimer: Developed by {author} — or Nahuel Zamuner, if you prefer.

not-found.title: Page not found
not-found.description: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or isn't available yet.

consent.title: Help us improve?
consent.message: We use Google tools (Tag Manager and Analytics) to learn which formulas are used most and improve the handbook. They only turn on if you accept; we never store the numbers you enter.
consent.preferences-description: Choose what we can use. You can change it anytime from "Cookie preferences" at the bottom of every page.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Keep your theme, language, currency, the latest values of each calculator and your session (if you signed in) on this device. The site does not work without them.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics: which pages are visited and which tools are used, in aggregate. Never the numbers you enter.

migration.title: We found data on this device
migration.description: You have settings, calculations or a history saved on this device. Do you want to move them to your account?
migration.import: Yes, save them to my account
